#!/bin/sh
# roblox-external-linux-020 — self-extracting Void/Sober payload
# Source commit: 7557113
# Packed by tools/pack_linux_payload.sh — do not hand-edit; repack instead.
set -u
UPDATE=020
SOURCE_COMMIT="7557113"
ARCHIVE_SHA256=c19db3e2ca2051c11b797d5bf10a11987c013c4ad1ac94e70e4c26ef92468a52
FILES=181
PAYLOAD_SHA256=09b4eaa79ed9ed23a62c1c63b703296dc15c4d5c323d8486f118d52b6e622f3f
[ -f "$0" ] || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=run-from-file"; exit 1; }
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=usage: sh /path/to/roblox-external-linux-020.txt /absolute/dir"; exit 1; }
DEST=$1
case "$DEST" in /*|[A-Za-z]:/*) ;; *) echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=absolute required"; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=target-already-exists:$DEST — run: rm -rf $DEST"; exit 1; fi
for c in base64 tar sha256sum mktemp; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=missing:$c"; exit 1; }; done
TMP=$(mktemp -d) || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=mktemp"; exit 1; }
b64d() { base64 -d "$1" 2>/dev/null || base64 -D "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
sed -n '/^__ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_PAYLOAD__$/,$p' "$0" | tail -n +2 > "$TMP/b64.txt"
b64d "$TMP/b64.txt" > "$TMP/src.tar.gz" 2>/dev/null || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=base64"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
GOT=$(sha256sum "$TMP/src.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT"
if [ "$GOT" != "$ARCHIVE_SHA256" ]; then echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=archive-sha want=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 got=$GOT"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; fi
mkdir -p "$DEST" || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=mkdir"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
tar -xzf "$TMP/src.tar.gz" -C "$DEST" || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=tar"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
rm -rf "$TMP"
GOT2=$(cd "$DEST" && find . -type f | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2"
if [ "$GOT2" != "$PAYLOAD_SHA256" ]; then echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_FAIL=payload-sha want=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 got=$GOT2"; exit 1; fi
echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_DONE=YES"
ls -lh "$DEST/assets/roblox-external.desktop" 2>&1 | head -n 5
echo "Next: sh $DEST/setup.sh"
echo "--- inverse ---"
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_WANT=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT PAYLOAD_SHA256_WANT=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2 FILES=$FILES DEST=$DEST"
exit 0
__ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_020_PAYLOAD__
